due_when.clears_when: every armed account shows read_state ok with a non-null day_start_equity on a deployed sha that contains PR 2, AND either a trip+reset pair has been observed (refusal journaled, one alert each) or 14 consecutive days of ok readings with no trip are recorded (stated as 'no trip observed', not as 'proven')

origin.rerun: GET /api/diag/log_file?name=daily_dd_switch_state (per-account day, day_start_equity, limit_usd, tripped, read_state, unreadable_streak); GET /api/diag/log_file?name=operator_alerts and grep kind daily_dd_switch; GET /api/diag/journal order_packages where reason='DAILY_DD_SWITCH'. Compare against GET /api/bot/config accounts[].daily_dd_switch.armed.

what: DAILY-DD-SWITCH is landed_unproven until observed live: after PR 1 (switch, all armed:false) and PR 2 (armed:true on every non-retired account) are merged AND deployed, the trader must fold a real equity reading into runtime_logs/daily_dd_switch_state.json for every armed account (read_state ok, day_start_equity set, limit_usd matching 3% / 0.8 x firm limit), and the first trip or first reset must be seen end to end: a DAILY_DD_SWITCH refusal in the journal plus exactly ONE 'Daily drawdown switch TRIPPED' alert, and ONE 'reset' alert after the account's day boundary. Merged != deployed != observed.
